memory_update.text: AMSC is the strongest US-listed underfollowed candidate for the grid-stability / high-voltage power-quality subnode because D-VAR STATCOM exposure maps directly to voltage stability, reactive-power support, power-factor correction, and renewable interconnection.
PLPC is a second-order transmission hardware candidate rather than a direct HVDC-reactor candidate; it should be tracked as an early-procurement BOM supplier for transmission and EHV buildout.
VSH may hide grid-stability component exposure inside a broad passive-components screen; ESTA power capacitors require follow-up to determine whether HVDC and grid power-quality revenue is material.

For US-listed equities, the most investable public mappings to this node appear to be STATCOM/reactive-power equipment, transmission-line hardware, and power capacitors rather than pure HVDC reactors or HVDC CTC magnet wire.

Direct HVDC reactor and backward-integrated HVDC CTC magnet-wire suppliers appear more likely to be found outside primary US listings; later passes should examine India, Canada, Europe, Japan, Korea, and OTC ADRs while checking liquidity and disclosure quality.

summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for the HVDC reactors / high-voltage power-quality / grid-stability component node using a two-lane Serenity funnel. The cleanest underfollowed US-listed exposures found in this pass are not pure HVDC reactor suppliers, but adjacent chokepoint beneficiaries: STATCOM/reactive-power systems, transmission-line hardware, and high-voltage power capacitors. Direct HVDC reactor and HVDC CTC magnet-wire exposure appears thinner among US-listed companies; this remains a coverage gap for later non-US or OTC work. No buy/sell recommendation is implied.
